body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #5, company drawn at random (seed 20261202) from IT/software services + banks/NBFCs in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.3) that: a Reg-30 board outcome approving a QIP, rights issue or preferential issue of equity (not ESOPs, not Tier 2/AT1 debt) is filed between 24-Nov-2026 and 30-Nov-2027. Our reasoning: MD (04-Nov-2026): no equity this FY, 'sometime in the next financial year ... We may not require this'; CRAR cushion Rs 306 cr vs 25-30% growth plans; post-merger holders may prefer a QIP. Naive base: [EST] roughly 1 in 3 Indian small-cap lenders approve an equity raise in any 12-month window. Resolution: YES if a Reg-30 board outcome approving a QIP, rights issue or preferential issue of equity (not ESOPs, not Tier 2/AT1 debt) is filed between 24-Nov-2026 and 30-Nov-2027. Source: NSE/BSE Reg-30 board outcomes. Resolve by 2027-11-30; score with Brier vs the base rate.
